preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 1000 for each test case.
Each element in the array is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if it's possible to throw out all elements, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: if YES, output x and the pairs of elements to be removed
postconditions.description: If it's possible, output the initial value of x and the pairs of elements removed in each operation.

invariants.description: The initial value of x must be a positive integer.
The number of operations must be exactly n.

invariants.expression: each pair of elements selected has a sum equal to x
invariants.description: Each pair of elements selected must have a sum equal to the current value of x.

invariants.expression: elements are removed and x is updated accordingly
invariants.description: After each operation, the selected elements are removed from the array, and x is updated to the maximum of the removed elements.
